From the manufacturer

  1. AEG5012

    Purpleheart Fretboard & Bridge


    Purpleheart produces a rich mid range with a crisp high end.

  2. AEG5012

    Sapele Back and Side


    Sapele back and sides offer a full-bodied and warm mid-range and a bright tone. The small and simple preamp has only two control knobs, volume and shape. This at-a-glance tone control offers natural acoustic sound in the center position. It allows players to adjust the tone easily and enables them to go from low, fat and powerful tones to a bright and crisp sound while adjusting only one knob. A new easy-to-read onboard tuner with LCD (liquid crystal display) is located on the preamp.

  3. AEG5012

    Okoume Neck


    The Okoume neck provides greater playing comfort.

  4. AEG5012

    Ibanez Advantage Bridge Pins


    These pins really are an advantage over old-fashioned pins. Advantage pins are easier to take out and easier to put in than standard pins. A special bulb-shaped end makes the pin easy to grip and also prevents the pin from being pushed in too far. Best of all, with Advantage the pin and string stay put.

Product Description

The AEG Series' slender, single-cutaway bodies deliver powerful and balanced acoustic sound, unplugged or through an amp or PA system. These guitars combine easy playability, classic solid and sunburst finishes, and intuitive electronics to create a quality, workhorse acoustic guitar that will rise to any occasion. High quality Ibanez under-saddle pickups and Ibanez preamps with onboard tuners provide sparkling tones that sound great in any environment.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

    Reviewed in the United States on August 2, 2021

    Been playing for 30 years and always wanted a 12 string. With prices this low figured why not. Ordered this and it showed up quickly. Very nice right out the box. The small G string popped on me and took an .010 string from a pile of them I have and tried that, popped that one too. Tried it again and it came right in tune. After that it took a few days for the strings to stop drifting out of tune and are now pretty solid. I play it daily and its a great player. This is one of those guitars you can just get lost in noodling. Plugged it up to my amp and it sounded great. No fret buzz and the neck plays easy. The built in tuner is a nice feature too.

    If you always wanted a 12 string acoustic/electric then this one is worth considering. It really is a beautiful guitar.

    I bought this guitar for my son to replace my twenty year old Takamine 12 string that he had been playing for the last five years.

    From my son's point of view, the guitar is easy to play for a 12 string. The onboard tuner is an upgrade from the older guitar because it also shows the battery life. It's also easy to read. The sound quality is bright and has a higher register. It is smaller than the Takamine. He said the fretboard was high quality.

    As for looks, it's a beautiful guitar. It's sleek and elegant.

    We're both happy with the purchase.

    Sounds amazing!
    Reviewed in the United States on November 25, 2023
    Color: Black
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    This brings plays very nicely. I bought the Vangoa 12 string from Amazon and was very disappointed so I replaced it with this Ibanez. The Vangoa did have a nice matte black finish but the tuners were garbage. This Ibanez has a satin neck and glossy body finish. Does have some sharp fret ends that can be fixed with some minor sanding. Tuners hold time nicely even though 12 strings are notoriously difficult to keep in tune. For estethic reasons I changed the tuners to bronze. The action after was great up to the 12th fret but too high afterwards so I did take out bridge saddle and sand it from the bottom end (approximately 1mm) to lower the overall action. There is a spare saddle included incase you need it. Worked out well afterwards. Overall would highly recommend if you’re looking play Pink Floyd Wish You Were Here or Bon Jovi songs lol at home but if you something more professional for recording then I would recommend something better.

    Came out of the box very badly out of tune. I'm talking wildly out of tune, 1.5-2 steps up or down in tuning. Not only this, but when I was able to get it in tune, almost every single string had fret buzz across the entire neck... I'm not sure how this was built, but I would not pay $50 for it.

    Action was good. The neck was flat; it should have been fine. I wasn't trying to fix this straight out of the box; I'm sending it back for a refund.

    I suggest you look at something else or risk having high action on a 12-string cutaway by adjusting the truss rod. NOPE

    Plays very smoothly and just my size.

    It arrived today, in great condition and I played it for an hour, heavily,(after tuning) and it held its tuning very well. I had left the sunburst model in my wish list too long and that color had run out, but I settled for a black one and it looks and plays great. I have small hands and to save my sciatic hip, I stand up to play, most of the time but it puts pressure on my neck so I need a lighter guitar. It has a nice balance (the neck is surprisingly on the heavy side but it balances the body very well, IMO. So it arrived by DHL and they kept me well informed of delivery. Love the guitar. I got a good one. ;-) I plugged it into the amp -- no problem. The guitar has a nice tone -- not too deep and not too bright when played acoustically. The price was right and the guitar was excellent, IMO
